integrity: The proof first expresses minimized quantile loss as a positive linear form in adjacent support gaps. A cut-indicator decomposition yields the sharp lower infimum; a probability-cell projection of the quantile score yields an exact covariance representation and the sharp upper supremum. Equality and nonattainment are reconstructed from the geometry of the projected score vector. Exact-rational computation only replays finite cases.
scientific_limitations: The theorem fixes a finite positive atom-probability profile and varies only distinct ordered support locations.
The result concerns unconditional minimized pinball loss normalized by the parent standard deviation, not conditional-quantile learning rates or estimator variance.
The originality search was targeted; an abstract convex-loss or isotonic-cone formulation in older literature may be equivalent.
title: Exact fixed-profile range of optimal quantile loss over standard deviation
